Episode-level bootstrap resampling provides 95\\\\% confidence intervals for all metrics.\\n\\n\\\\subsection{Problem Setup}\\n\\\\label{sec:problem-setup}\\n\\nConsider an interactive environment $\\\\mathcal{E}$ with state space $\\\\mathcal{S}$, observation space $\\\\mathcal{O}$, and action space $\\\\mathcal{A}$. DAF CI [81.6%, 98.8%] 使用的是 **episode-level bootstrap**：

- **B = 10,000** resamples, seed = 42

- 取 percentile-based 95% CI（2.5th 和 97.5th percentile）
- 论文原文: *"Episode-level bootstrap resampling (B=10,000 resamples)... each resample draws N=245 episodes with replacement, recomputes Δ_full, Δ_nd, and DAF"*
